outcome: incidence rates of trial of labors after cesarean section (TOLACs)
annual rates of vaginal births after cesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: Nulliparous women having their first and second pregnancy between 1998-2018 in Finland
finding: Despite the increasing annual total number of deliveries with CS in the first pregnancy, the absolute numbers and rates for VBACs have increased towards the end of the study period in Finland.
mod_finding: The study found that despite an increase in first-time cesarean sections, the rates of vaginal births after cesarean section (VBAC) have increased in Finland.
